subject: Service degradation and remediation — request for compensation
messages:
From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@payedge.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: sophie.lee@payedge.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform 5xx/429 spike impacting PayEdge (urgent)

Dylan —

We experienced a service-wide degradation this morning between ~08:40–09:10 PT where ~18% of our inference calls to the Redwood hosted endpoint returned 5xx/429 and a number of calls timed out client-side. This caused retry storms on our side and several downstream failures across payment processing. We've filed internal tickets and paused automated retries but want to escalate to get clarity on root cause and compensation for the outage window.

Attached is a snapshot from our gateway showing failed request rates and a short timeline. Can you share Redwood's incident timeline, root cause, and proposed credits? This impacted peak traffic and materially affected our processing SLA with merchants.

We need an initial response and remediation plan within the hour — our Ops and Legal teams are standing by.

— Carlos Ruiz
Head of Integrations, PayEdge
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@payedge.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform 5xx/429 spike impacting PayEdge (urgent)

Carlos —

Thanks for the heads up and for the data. I'm escalating immediately. High level: engineering has observed elevated 5xx and 429s on our us-west cluster coincident with a downstream cache invalidation and a mis-scheduled rolling restart that briefly reduced capacity. We're assembling a timeline and mitigation notes now.

Next steps:
- Rishi (copied) will post a preliminary incident timeline and mitigation steps within 30 minutes.
- We'll run a targeted request replay and provide an estimate of impacted requests/tokens within the hour.
- I'll propose a compensation calculation for the affected window and follow up once we confirm numbers.

I know this was disruptive — we'll prioritize PayEdge and loop in an exec if needed.

— Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform 5xx/429 spike impacting PayEdge (urgent)

Dylan / Evelyn —

Prelim triage summary (INC-20260518-17):
- Root cause (prelim): a scheduled rolling restart of a caching tier overlapped with an automated cache-prefetch job. The overlap caused a surge of cache-miss load to inference pods; autoscaler reacted but there was a short capacity gap (~3–6 minutes) producing elevated 429s, and a longer tail of retries produced transient 5xxs.
- Impact window (observed): 08:38–09:12 PT (peaked 08:45–08:50).
- Observed symptoms: 18% error rate peak across a subset of colocated nodes, elevated p95/p99 latency, localized token queuing.
- Mitigation taken: rolled back the prefetch job, increased soft-limits on affected pools, and applied a temporary routing policy to divert PayEdge traffic to a healthy node pool at 09:05. Full steady state recovered by ~09:20 after KV cache warmed.
- Data we will provide: request counts by minute, error class breakdown, and the replay-analysis CSV (attached).

I'll run the request replay against our logs and provide an estimated impacted request/token count within two hours. Recommend we offer an interim goodwill credit while we finalize numbers.

— Rishi
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@payedge.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@payedge.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform 5xx/429 spike impacting PayEdge (urgent)

Dylan / Redwood team —

Thanks for the quick initial notes. PayEdge is requesting:
1) A summary of requests impacted (we need a count and time breakdown)
2) A credit calculation consistent with our contract (we reference the SLA in section 4.2; our legal team will produce a formal ask but prelim we expect a pro-rated credit for the 34 minute window plus a goodwill gesture for the downstream merchant impact)
3) Confirmation you will add retry-safety guidance / recommended client backoff to avoid amplification during partial outages

Please escalate to Sales leadership if you cannot confirm a compensation approach today — we need to include this in our merchant communication later today.

— Sophie
Senior Counsel, PayEdge
From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@payedge.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@payedge.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform 5xx/429 spike impacting PayEdge (incident + credit proposal)

Sophie / Carlos —

Thanks for the patience. We've completed replay and impact estimation: preliminary impacted calls = 62,400 requests (approx. 1.9M tokens) during 08:38–09:12 PT. Attached is the replay CSV and a snapshot of the error KPI.

Credit proposal (initial):
- Per our standard SLA methodology: prorated credit for the affected time window = 100% of service fees attributable to that 34-minute window (calculated pro rata on monthly usage).
- Goodwill: an additional one-off 10% credit on the affected-use charges to help offset merchant remediation costs.
- We will notate mitigations taken and a plan to prevent recurrence (engineering will publish a brief postmortem and recommended client-side backoff patterns within 72 hours).

If PayEdge prefers an alternative calculation (e.g., token-based refund vs time-window prorate) we're open to a quick call to agree. I'm happy to route the paperwork to Billing / Finance once you confirm.

Next: Sean (VP Sales) is cc'd and available for any executive handoff.

— Dylan
From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@payedge.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@payedge.com>, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Platform 5xx/429 spike impacting PayEdge (incident + credit proposal)

Dylan / Sean —

Appreciate the detailed analysis and the interim proposal. PayEdge accepts the time-window prorated credit and the one-off 10% goodwill credit. Sophie will follow up for formal paperwork, and we'll need a short joint statement we can share with impacted merchants that summarizes the cause and steps taken.

Please route the credit paperwork to accounts-payable@payedge.com and copy our legal team. Also confirm the postmortem publication ETA so we can align merchant comms.

— Carlos
